children: Brazil's central bank said on Friday it will offer a total of up to $2 billion across two simultaneous dollar auctions with repurchase agreements on Monday.

The central bank said in a statement the auctions will start at 10:30 a.m. local time (1330 GMT). The repurchases for the auctions are set for April 2 and October 4 of next year, according to the monetary authority.
